english.title: Use prohibited means to capture / kill protected animal species by aircraft or moving motor vehicle
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) for the purpose of capturing or killing

(A)_[a wild animal,]_
(B)_[wild animals,]_

of a

(C)_[species listed in Schedule 4 to]_
(D)_[European protected species, where the capturing or killing of such animals was permitted in accordance with]_

the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMALS..), used a form of capturing or killing from

(E)_[an aircraft]_
(F)_[aircraft]_
(G)_[a moving motor vehicle]_
(H)_[moving motor vehicles]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 45(2)(b), (5) and (6) of the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Schedule 4 to the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017 lists animals which may not be captured or killed in certain ways.
